response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and platforms, but lacks the specific C++ and Windows platform experience required for the role. Additionally, there is no demonstrated domain expertise in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking, nor any exposure to the mandatory technical skills like SQL Server/Oracle or Summit platform. While their communication skills and general C++ experience (notably in C/C++ at National Instruments) are evident, these do not compensate for the critical gaps.
strengths: Strong general software development experience across multiple languages and domains
Proven ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly
Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and database management (MongoDB, MySQL)
concerns: No significant C++ development experience on Windows platform (only limited C/C++ at National Instruments)
No domain expertise in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking
Lacks mandatory SQL Server/Oracle experience and Summit platform exposure
